places.reason: First character needs an identifying noun phrase.
The mother should be introduced by her relationship.
住在 does not take 了 before 在.
靠墓地的家 is understandable and acceptable.
家 needs 里 to mark the living location clearly.
Sentence-final 了 can mark the change to this daily behavior.
No city has been introduced for 那个 to refer to.
在 is optional with this habitual activity.
Unable to buy a house is not the story’s reason for moving.
到 must precede the completed-action 了.
Deleting 到 would make 搬了别一个城市 ungrammatical.
另一个 is the appropriate expression for another city.
